I'm Kartheek Saradhi, a software engineer based working on APIs and platform systems. I hold a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing from IIT Hyderabad.

In early 2024 I did a research internship fine-tuning language models for content moderation (sexism detection). It was my first time fine-tuning a model, and I enjoyed the whole process: the thinking, the experiments, and the discussions that went into the work, alongside a great research team I was lucky to work with. After the internship, a re-org moved me into pure software engineering, and over the next two years I lost track of LLM developments: agents, RLHF, DPO and much more.

This site is how I'm catching up. I'm not a researcher and I don't have a master's degree, just a decent math background and a long backlog. I write up what I learn as articles, grouped into [series](series.qmd) meant to be read in order.

The articles follow *The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI* by Haggai Roitman (CC BY-SA 4.0). Each one is a standalone adaptation. The book is the source, and the best place to go deeper.
